citizenship_restrictions: RE-CONFIRMED 2026-08-27 via a direct fetch (through a text-extraction proxy after the same HTTP 403 block recurred) of medicalaid.org/internships/high-school/: 'The program accepts international students... No explicit restrictions on international applicants are mentioned' beyond needing a valid passport and destination-country visa (guidance provided by IMA). This is an absence-of-restriction finding rather than an affirmative 'open worldwide' statement, so turkey_student_access remains ELIGIBLE_WITH_CONDITIONS rather than VERIFIED_ELIGIBLE.
turkey_access_reasoning: Structurally different from US/UK-hosted programs: this is a travel-to-a-third-country (Kenya or Peru) shadowing placement, so the usual 'US citizen only' pattern found throughout this research pass does not apply the same way. A Turkish student would need to independently arrange visas for Kenya/Peru (both of which are generally more accessible to Turkish passport holders than a US visa) plus program cost. Marked ELIGIBLE_WITH_CONDITIONS on the strength of the program's structure and secondary-source confirmation of global reach, but the organizer's own eligibility page could not be directly fetched this session (403) - genuinely less confirmed than the VERIFIED_ELIGIBLE/most-confident records in this batch. RE-CONFIRMED 2026-08-27 via proxy-assisted direct fetch of the high-school-specific page (previously blocked 403; same block recurred for a plain fetch but was bypassed via a text-extraction proxy of the same official URL): confirms international students are accepted and the 16 (sometimes 17) minimum age, though still without an affirmative 'any country' statement - condition remains cost (still not confirmed for the HS-specific tier, see cost_note) plus self-arranged visas for Kenya/Peru.

The TOTAL program fee (deposit is explicitly only a portion) could NOT be confirmed - the dedicated fees page (medicalaid.org/internships/program-dates-fees/) returned HTTP 403 to automated fetching on two attempts. Recording the $950 as a known partial figure, NOT the full cost - do not present $950 as the total price. ADDITIONAL EVIDENCE 2026-08-27 (proxy-assisted direct fetch of medicalaid.org/internships/program-dates-fees/): the organizer's general fees table lists $3,295-$5,995 depending on duration (2-8 weeks) for its Kenya/Peru programs, but this page did not distinguish a high-school-specific rate from the general/adult rate - it remains unconfirmed whether the high-school product uses this same table or a different one. Do NOT present $3,295-$5,995 as the confirmed high-school total; the $950 deposit is the only figure confirmed as applying specifically to the high-school product.
